question: B is the father of O. O is the wife of A. A is the brother of T. T is the daughter of S. How is B related to S?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png]

B is the father of O.

O is the wife of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ffc2bad2b39537b2c4fce10edaee2cfa3f438762b4f7b5de464e700fbad2482.png]
